reason: It's a brand new page and I've never seen anyone on TikTok unbox something from them, and my cousin already lost a deposit to a page like this. I'm not paying up front to someone nobody I know has used yet.
objection: I pay the item price first and then wait three weeks for something from China, so if they disappear my money is gone, just like my cousin's. And 21,000 in fees on 30,000 shoes is a lot for me.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real unboxing videos from Baghdad people on TikTok, or a friend getting an order from them with no surprise fees, and being able to pay everything on delivery.
